prior_importants.description: All five issue forms say the operator applies `ready` once the ticket passes intake, which reverses ADR 0176: `ready` is applied first (by the operator or a write-access collaborator) and intake then checks the fields and removes it on failure.

process_issues.description: The delta (5f68aea..4a3eb8d) is one sentence reworded identically in the five issue forms (10 lines, prose only), so the gated roster is docs and conventions. Skipped: correctness and security (no logic and no trust boundary), context (no protocol or infra surface in the delta), simplicity (no new construct), guards (no non-test source), workflow-safety (ISSUE_TEMPLATE is not .github/workflows), spec (no closing issue or --spec source), and maintainability (off the default roster). Prior important prior_importants[0] (the `ready` order) is resolved: all five forms now say `ready` is applied first and intake then checks it and removes it, which matches ADR 0176 lines 10-12.
